params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: Background removal reads the original with a bare `get()`, which the bucket disk answers with null when a read fails. The photo then goes to remove.bg empty, the 400 is reported, and the platform copy stays without a cut-out and without a blurred plate.

## What happened

Three times on 2026-10-10 (Nightwatch #61): `RequestException` 400 `missing_source` from remove.bg, for three platform copies (`stocklist_car_image_N.jpg`) on two vehicles. All three files are in the bucket now, with normal sizes. The job had just copied each one and checked that the copy existed, then read it back for remove.bg and got nothing: the `vehicles` S3 disk does not throw, so a timeout or a 5xx on the GET becomes null, and `base64_encode(null)` is an empty part.

Because the cut-out step failed, `ProcessImage` stopped before the blur: those copies have no `trans_path` and their plates were not blurred.

#984 described this as a missing original. Its pull request (#986) was merged without the change in it (the proposal took the files from an uncommitted HEAD), so #984 is closed but nothing changed; and the change it described would have labelled these photos "original no longer on the server", which is wrong here.

## Expected

Read the original the way the sweeper does (`VehicleImageService::readSource()` inside `StorageUnavailable::retryOnce()`): null only when the bucket says the file is not there (`SOURCE_MISSING`, nothing sent, not reported); a file that is there but whose bytes do not come is asked again once, and a second failure is a storage fault (reported, `SERVICE_REFUSED`, nothing sent). Never an empty image to remove.bg.

Source: Portal mail:12 (a forwarded Nightwatch notification), with the production check done afterwards.
params.title: Background removal sends remove.bg an empty image when a bucket read fails
